title: Shared atoms of the provider-role contract
description: Referenced by the other provider-role schemas; validates nothing on its own.

identifier.description: An identifier for a provider, publisher, party, node, network, asset or class.

version.description: A provider version, as its publisher names it.

amount.description: A non-negative whole number of the tuple's unit, in decimal digits with no leading zeros.

timestamp.description: A UTC time in RFC 3339 form, to the second or finer, ending in Z.

evidence_grade.description: ADR-0007's scale: 1 checkable by anyone; 2 signed by another party; 3 signed by the provider, with something external to compare later; 4 the provider's bare statement.

decimal.description: A positive decimal number, in digits with an optional fraction and no exponent.

protocol_version.description: A protocol version, as major.minor.patch (REQ-PRT-1, REQ-PRT-4).

public_key.description: An Ed25519 public key (RFC 8032), 32 bytes, base64url without padding, in its one canonical encoding: the last character carries no unused bits.

safe_integer.description: A non-negative integer no larger than 2^53 - 1, so it survives RFC 8785 canonical JSON, which writes numbers as IEEE doubles.
